# Danto

> Danto is a client portal and project board for freelancers and small agencies. Each client gets a live, branded web page showing project progress; clients approve deliverables in one click, submit new requests, and receive AI-written weekly status updates. Clients never need an account.

Website: https://danto.app
Support: support@danto.app

## What Danto does
- Live client portal: a private, no-login link per project showing progress, stages, due dates and what's waiting on the client.
- One-click approvals: freelancers press "Request approval" on a deliverable; the client approves or requests changes from an email or the portal. Every approval is recorded with name and time.
- Request intake: clients submit new requests from the portal; they become cards on the freelancer's board.
- AI client updates: drafts a weekly status email (done, next, waiting on you) from the live board; only client-visible cards are used.
- Internal cards: anything marked internal never appears in the portal or AI updates.
- Branding: logo, business name and accent colour on portals and client emails (Pro); white-label without Danto branding (Team).
- AI project planner: paste a brief, meeting notes or a proposal and get a structured board.

## Pricing (USD, billed monthly, cancel anytime)
- Free: $0. 1 live client portal, approvals and client requests, 3 boards, 10 AI actions per month.
- Pro: $19/month. Unlimited client portals, custom branding, AI client updates sent from Danto, approval emails, 3 teammates, 300 AI actions per month.
- Team: $49/month. Everything in Pro plus white-label portals, 10 teammates, Workspace Pulse overview, 1,500 AI actions per month, priority support.

## Who it's for
Freelance designers, web developers, marketers, video editors, consultants and small studios who manage several client projects and want clients informed without status meetings or long email threads.
